قَنِىَ الحَيَاءَ * He kept to the sense of shame, or modesty; (S, K;) he preserved it: and i. q. اِسْتَحْيَى: and ↓ اِسْتَقْنَى he kept to [or preserved] his sense of shame, or modesty. (TA.) ― -b2- قَنَا غَنَمًا, and ↓ اِقْتَنَى, He took for himself, got, or acquired, sheep, or goats [for a permanent possession], not for sale. (JK.) ― -b3- قَنَا, aor. يَقْنُو, inf. n. قُنُوٌّ; a dial. var. of قَنَأَ, q. v. (TA.)
قَانَى * : see قَانَأَ.
اقْتَنَى * He gained, acquired, or got, for himself, (S, K,) or took for himself, (Mgh,) property, or camels, &c., (S, Mgh,) as a permanent stock, for propagation, (Mgh,) not for merchandise: (S, Mgh:) he made it to be in his possession, not to depart from his hand: (TA:) he acquired it for himself permanently, or for a permanence. See 1.
